name: prompt-370
image_vibe: Sophisticated gothic glamour, photorealistic black lace, soft studio contrast
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion gothic lookbook portrait with detailed lace and material rendering.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-photorealistic studio portrait of an original adult woman in a gothic-inspired bunny fashion ensemble.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with luminous natural skin texture, long flowing wavy black hair, defined brows, dark eyes, matte red or deep-berry lipstick, precise winged eyeliner, and a confident composed expression. She wears a black lace bunny-ear headband, fitted black velvet or leather choker, structured black strapless corset dress or top-and-skirt ensemble with visible boning and lacing, sheer black thigh-high stockings with lace top band, and black pointed heels with ankle straps.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium vertical portrait from mid-thigh upward, centered with subtle negative space, kneeling on a light studio floor, one hand beside the knee and the other resting near the thigh, slightly turned with a poised fashion silhouette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Softbox or parabolic diffuser from front-left, subtle right fill and rear hair light, creamy highlights, deep soft shadows, accurate material reflections, and refined gothic editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm f/1.2 or 85mm f/1.4 full-frame look, ISO 100, f/1.8, 1/160s, 8K photorealistic PBR material rendering, shallow depth of field, light-gray/off-white seamless backdrop, no text or watermark.
